description: This PHP source file defines the class DropDownHelper, which provides methods for managing dropdown lists in the SuiteCRM project. It includes functions for scanning modules for dropdown definitions, filtering dropdowns, and saving/updating dropdown lists, along with handling related caching and configuration.

classes.name: DropDownHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing dropdown list definitions within the SuiteCRM system, including scanning modules for dropdowns, filtering, and saving dropdown configurations.

methods.name: getDropDownModules
methods.description: Scans the modules directory to identify modules that contain an EditView.php file and scans those files for dropdown list definitions.

methods.name: scanForDropDowns
methods.description: Reads a specific file, searches for app_list_strings array definitions, and records identified dropdowns associated with a particular module.

methods.name: filterDropDown
methods.description: Filters a given dropdown list based on the module’s visibility settings, used mainly for pre-5.0 studio editing constraints.

methods.name: saveDropDown
methods.description: Processes request parameters to update or create dropdown list definitions, updating corresponding language files and clearing caches.
